data.body:
[P2] Allow newly opened replay segments to complete

A parallel branch can complete a large-result child, then resume a timed wait within the same invocation while another branch remains running. Re-entering that child with `ReplayChildren=True` makes `on_user_function_start` open a fresh span for the same operation ID. This guard suppresses its subsequent End because the first segment already populated the ledger. The new segment remains `STARTED`/`UNSET` until invocation cleanup, losing its successful outcome and correct duration. Distinguish repeated checkpoint notifications from completion of a newly opened context segment, and add a timed-resume regression covering this sequence.
